proposed_contract.name: RwoAdapterContract@candidate-1
invariants: Transport success is not journal acceptance, Work completion, domain truth, or effect authorization.
Redelivery changes transport attempt metadata only; a new Work Attempt is an RWO decision.
Acknowledgement, offset, inbox, outbox, and dead-letter state cannot substitute for the journal.
Capability absence is explicit and no profile claims exactly-once business effects.

findings.counterexample: broker acknowledgement succeeds while journal append fails
findings.repair: separate command, event, and journal acceptance ports; route only from accepted record refs

findings.counterexample: universal at-least-once excludes or causes false claims from memory and RPC adapters
findings.repair: move durability, ordering, replay, and flow control to admitted profiles

findings.counterexample: transport message ID replaces logical identity on redelivery
findings.repair: separate immutable canonical identity from mutable transport metadata
journal alone owns accepted sequence and replay cursor

findings.counterexample: timeout or dead-letter state selects Work retry

blockers: Journal structural acceptance versus work-owned domain truth remains an owner gate.
Exact-effect permit and reconciliation remain owner gates.
No adapter/profile pair has executable conformance evidence.
